base_method.inheritance: Every lateral operator, transition operator, pair materialization rule, proxy metric, ranking field, stable tie break, exact dedup rule, P3 reconstruction rule, final candidate rank, and exact validator contract is byte-defined by the base serialization and inherited unchanged unless explicitly overridden below.

only_method_override.coverage_rule: Run the existing global DISJOINT_COVERAGE selector once for four shapes, with all eight lexicographic shapes pre-excluded and the four reserve choices accumulated in one diversity state.
only_method_override.ordered_output: eight lexicographic factors followed by four global disjoint-coverage factors
only_method_override.coverage_proxy_and_ties: Inherited without change from base standaloneCoverageOrder DISJOINT_COVERAGE.

integration_geometry_binding.rule: Cheap GQSC corridor construction reads the same effective RacelineSplineParameters instance as planning-context construction and exact validation.
bound_fields: obstacle_reserve_from_lut and its effective tracking-error reserve
integration_geometry_binding.relaxed_context_rule: When obstacle_reserve_from_lut is enabled and the strict cheap corridor is closed at the obstacle midpoint, rebuild only that side's cheap geometry with the existing operational minimum-speed clearance envelope before declaring no geometry; exact validation remains unchanged and authoritative.
integration_geometry_binding.canonical_seen_profile_parity: The frozen seen corpus uses 0.15 m vehicle half-width, 0.08 m obstacle safety margin, 0.04 m wall margin, zero LUT reserve, and zero longitudinal padding, so this binding reproduces the base geometry exactly there.

explicit_exclusions: legacy M0/M1 or exact-R3 seed execution
